summaries.Good news: People are choosing radical kindness—crowdfunding retirements for strangers, building safe spaces for unhoused youth, and painting celebrations of nature restoration. Real progress is happening through human connection and collective care.
summaries.Ideas: Design thinking and human judgment are becoming AI's competitive advantage as companies race forward; the real question is what we're willing to sacrifice in the speed to scale.
summaries.Technology: Practical innovation is everywhere: from modular interfaces that respect repairability, to AI agents entering commerce at scale, to breakthrough discoveries in nature (bee venom pumps, ancient fungi) that humble our assumptions.
summaries.Design: Architecture and product design are merging art with function—converting industrial spaces into music schools, creating interactive installations with 221 camera obscuras, and designing for ecosystems (magpie behavior research informing landscape design).
